note: The English of every fit_note and licence note the catalog writes, keyed by its Chinese; {product} and {runtimes} are filled in the catalog.
面向{product}的专用技能，需要该产品的账号或环境。: Made for {product}; it needs that product's account or environment.
需要本机安装并配置 {product} 命令行工具。: Needs the {product} command-line tool installed and set up.
面向编程智能体的代码工作流，在 Mibo 中用处有限。: A coding agent's workflow; of limited use in Mibo.
依赖其他智能体宿主的功能（如插件、子代理或斜杠命令），在 Mibo 中无法完整使: Relies on another agent host's features (plugins, subagents or slash commands); Mibo can use only part of it.
需要连接 MCP 服务器，Mibo 尚未接入该服务器时只能使用说明部分。: Needs an MCP server; until Mibo is connected to it, only the written guidance applies.
需要第三方服务的 API 密钥。: Needs an API key for a third-party service.
需要图像生成服务，Mibo 本身不提供。: Needs an image generation service, which Mibo does not provide.
依赖子代理并行工作，Mibo 只能按顺序完成其中一部分。: Relies on subagents working in parallel; Mibo does part of it in sequence.
开源许可，允许使用与再分发；修改后再分发须沿用相同许可。: An open licence allowing use and redistribution; changed copies must keep the same licence.
未声明许可：作者未授予再分发许可，只能从其来源取得，仅供个人使用。: No licence stated: the author grants no redistribution, so it is fetched from its source for personal use only.
许可禁止商业用途，此处不提供安装，请前往来源查看条款。: The licence forbids commercial use; not installable here, see its source for the terms.
许可限定了使用范围或无法归入公开许可，此处不提供安装，请前往来源查看条款。: The licence limits where it may be used or is not a public licence; not installable here, see its source for the terms.
